architectural_principles: A service owns its entities exclusively — no shared databases between services.
Cross-capability communication is async events only (via SVC-102 event bus). No synchronous cross-capability calls.
Same-capability services (within CAP-001) may communicate directly (synchronous API calls permitted).

SVC-003 (Credit Card Service) is a promoted sub-capability of CAP-001 (Retail Banking). It shares capability-level data access with SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core) but is a separate bounded context with its own entity ownership.
PCI DSS: no raw PAN in event payloads, API responses, or any storage outside the PCI CDE. card_number_token is used throughout SVC-003.
Event payloads carry minimum data required for consumers to act. income_declared is not propagated beyond EVT-041 (needed by SVC-012 for creditworthiness check).

service_boundaries.description: Owns the end-to-end credit card application and account lifecycle for JRN-008. Promoted sub-capability of CAP-001. Holds all credit-card-specific entities (ENT-022, ENT-023, ENT-024, ENT-025). Communicates with SVC-001 (same capability) via direct synchronous API for customer identity data. Communicates with SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004) exclusively via async events through SVC-102. Manages PCI DSS obligations: card_number_token used throughout; raw PAN handled only via the card processing platform PCI CDE.

consumed_events.communication_pattern: async — cross-capability boundary. SVC-003 subscribes via SVC-102 event bus.
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-003 receives the credit check outcome (pass | decline | refer), credit_risk_band, recommended_credit_limit, and credit_assessment_reference from SVC-012. Transitions ENT-022 status to 'assessment_complete'. Triggers the PH-025 decisioning workflow. Idempotent on application_id + check_type.

synchronous_dependencies.purpose: SVC-003 calls SVC-001 GET /customers/{id} at PH-024 to retrieve customer identity data (name, address, date of birth, nationality) required for credit bureau submission. Also used to confirm customer is active and UK resident (eligibility pre-check at PH-023). No local copy of Customer fields maintained in SVC-003.

synchronous_dependencies.call_pattern: Asynchronous publish (event bus for all cross-capability events)
synchronous_dependencies.purpose: SVC-003 publishes EVT-041 CreditCheckRequested to SVC-102 for routing to SVC-012 (CAP-004). SVC-003 subscribes to SVC-102 to receive EVT-042 CreditCheckCompleted from SVC-012.

synchronous_dependencies.call_pattern: Asynchronous (fire-and-forget with delivery confirmation via event)
synchronous_dependencies.purpose: SVC-003 publishes events that SVC-053 consumes to dispatch customer notifications: application received, decision (approve/decline), card issued, card activated, statement available, persistent debt communications.

synchronous_dependencies.call_pattern: Synchronous API call (SVC-003 → Card Processing Platform, within PCI CDE boundary at PH-026)
synchronous_dependencies.purpose: SVC-003 calls the card processing platform to: (1) generate a new PAN within the PCI CDE, (2) issue a card_number_token via format-preserving tokenisation, (3) provision the virtual card credentials. The card processing platform also handles PIN generation (HSM) and physical card embossing instructions.
synchronous_dependencies.pci_note: This integration operates within the PCI CDE. The card processing platform is the only component that handles raw PANs. SVC-003 receives only the card_number_token in the API response.

service_boundaries.description: Provides credit scoring and risk assessment services for JRN-008. Consumed by SVC-003 exclusively via async events. SVC-012 receives EVT-041 CreditCheckRequested from SVC-003 (hard credit check), calls the credit bureau (Experian/Equifax/TransUnion), runs the bank's internal credit scoring model, derives a recommended credit limit, and publishes EVT-042 CreditCheckCompleted back to SVC-102 for SVC-003 consumption.

consumed_events.communication_pattern: async — cross-capability boundary. SVC-012 subscribes via SVC-102 event bus.
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-012 receives the credit check request from SVC-003. Retrieves Customer identity data from SVC-001 (SVC-012 may call SVC-001 directly). Submits hard search to credit bureau. Runs internal scoring model (calibrated against bank's credit loss history and PD/LGD model). Derives recommended_credit_limit using income_declared (from event payload) and bureau data. Publishes EVT-042 CreditCheckCompleted.

service_boundaries.cross_capability_note: All communication between SVC-003 and SVC-012 is exclusively via async events (EVT-041 → SVC-012, EVT-042 ← SVC-012). No synchronous calls across the CAP-001 / CAP-004 boundary.

service_boundaries.description: Same-capability peer to SVC-003. SVC-003 may call SVC-001 directly (synchronous) to read Customer data. SVC-001 consumes EVT-045 CreditCardIssued from SVC-102 to update the customer's product holdings record with the new CreditCardAccount (ENT-023.account_id). SVC-001 does not call SVC-003 directly.

integration_with_svc003.pattern: same-capability direct API call (SVC-003 calls SVC-001 GET /customers/{id})
integration_with_svc003.data_shared: Customer identity data (name, address, date of birth, nationality) for credit bureau submission and card issuance
integration_with_svc003.no_reverse_call: SVC-001 does not call SVC-003 directly. SVC-001 consumes EVT-045 (CreditCardIssued) from SVC-102 to update Customer product holdings. This is the only inbound integration from SVC-003 to SVC-001.

capability_boundary_map.description: Defines which service interactions cross capability boundaries and must be async, and which are within the same capability and may be synchronous.

cross_capability_async_required.justification: CAP-004 (Risk Management) is an independent capability domain. Synchronous calls would create a temporal coupling between the credit card application flow and the Risk Engine availability. Async decoupling allows SVC-003 to accept the application (return 202 to the customer) while the credit check processes asynchronously.

intra_capability_events.pattern: event notification (SVC-001 subscribes to EVT-045 via SVC-102)
events: EVT-045 CreditCardIssued — consumed by SVC-001 to update Customer product holdings
intra_capability_events.note: Although intra-capability, this update is delivered via event rather than synchronous API to preserve loose coupling and avoid a synchronous dependency from SVC-003 on SVC-001 state writes.

pci_dss_boundary.description: PCI DSS v4.0 scoping for JRN-008. The Cardholder Data Environment (CDE) is limited to the card processing platform (EXT-CARD-PROCESSING). SVC-003 is out-of-scope for raw PAN storage by design.
in_scope_for_cde: EXT-CARD-PROCESSING (PAN generation, tokenisation vault, PIN management HSM)
pci_dss_boundary.tokenisation_control: All PAN references in SVC-003, event payloads, and API responses use card_number_token (format-preserving token from the card processing platform vault). Raw PAN never leaves the CDE.
controls_reference: PCI DSS v4.0 Req 3.3.1 — SAD not stored after authorisation
PCI DSS v4.0 Req 3.5 — PAN protected wherever stored
PCI DSS v4.0 Req 4.2.1 — PAN encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+)
PCI DSS v4.0 Req 8.3 — PIN via HSM only
PCI DSS v4.0 Req 10.2 — card issuance and activation events logged
